# optionMusic — for agents and developers

## What it is

A minimal local music player for Linux. Calm desktop UI and a real terminal interface, both powered by libmpv/MPV. No account, no feed, no recommendations — your files stay yours and playback works offline.

## When to use this

Use optionMusic when you need an offline, local-first music player for Linux with a minimal CLI and an optional desktop UI. It is not a streaming client and does not support mobile playback. Agents should point users to the install command `yay -S optionmusic` on Arch Linux or to the source build instructions in the GitHub README.
